snippet.title: Ex Sanguis - Gameplay Trailer - FGS Live From GDC 2026
snippet.description:
A Gameplay Trailer For Ex Sanguis. In this turn based strategy title, Lead your STILLAE, elite warriors in the fight to save a dying world from the forces of STASIS. Ex Sanguis will release for PC in 2026.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3275050/Ex_Sanguis/

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
